get.description:
Returns the Saved Views a Project user can see: their own plus every project-level Saved View. Unusable Saved Views are never returned.

By default only Saved Views belonging to a Document Collection are returned. Passing `filters[upload_collection_ids]` or `filters[recycle_bin_collection_ids]` scopes the response to Saved Views on those collections instead. A Saved View belongs to at most one collection, so at most one of `document_collection_id`, `upload_collection_id` and `recycle_bin_collection_id` is non-null.

Recycle Bin Saved Views are only returned when the Recycle Bin is enabled for the Project; when it is not, scoping to them returns an empty page rather than an error.

Supported filters: `ids`, `updated_at`, `document_collection_ids`, `upload_collection_ids`, `recycle_bin_collection_ids`.

Pass `view=ids_only` to receive an array of Saved View ids instead of full objects.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Optional response view. Omit or pass `default` for full Saved View objects. `ids_only` returns an array of ids and raises the `per_page` ceiling from 100 to 5000. The published `per_page` maximum reflects the default view.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Language for the response to be translated into

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description:
Object with whitelisted Field ids as keys and their corresponding MetadataValue id, MetadataValue ids array, or primitive string value as values.
Valid filterable fields are:
ids,
updated_at,
document_collection_ids,
upload_collection_ids,
recycle_bin_collection_ids

200.description: Returns a list of Saved Views

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next and last link

tags.description: The tags on a saved view

filters.description: The filters on a saved view

key.description: Can be a Field ID or some other supported table filter key (ex: document_collection_index_type)

key_type.description: Indicates what type of filter this is

document_collection_id.description: The Document Collection this saved view belongs to. Null for saved views outside a Document Collection.

upload_collection_id.description: The Upload Collection this saved view belongs to. Null for saved views outside an Upload Collection.

description.example: Filters by Type=Drawing and Status=Approved,Approved with Comment

share_type.description: Categorizes the saved view as a user level saved view or a project level saved view.

shortcut_type.description: PDM tool alias that are permanent saved views on all projects

deletable.description: Determines whether a saved view can be deleted or not

columns_config.description: The table configuration for the saved view

key.description: Can be a Field ID or some other supported table column key

key_type.description: Indicates what type of column this is

last_accessed_at.description: Last accessed timestamp for the saved view

access_count.description: Number of times this saved view has been accessed

recycle_bin_collection_id.description: The Recycle Bin Collection this saved view belongs to. Null for every saved view outside the Recycle Bin.

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v2.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/document_management/saved_views?view=SOME_STRING_VALUE&page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&locale=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters=SOME_OBJECT_VALUE")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
